name: oss_upload
description: Upload a file to z-oss (S3-compatible object storage) under a bucket and key. Use this when the CEO agent needs to persist binary content: a screenshot of a dashboard, a generated PDF, an exported CSV, a log file. The file is passed as base64 (or referenced via path if uploading from local disk). Returns the object's URL. Backed by POST /api/v1/object/{bucket}/{key}. Requires z-ctc 'oss:write' permission. Buckets are created on first use if the account has createBucket authority.

bucket.description: Bucket name. Use semantic names like 'ceo-screenshots', 'ceo-exports', 'operation-logs'. Lowercase + hyphens.

key.description: Object key (path within bucket). Use forward slashes for hierarchy. e.g. '2026/06/screenshot-001.png' or 'logs/2026-06-24/app.log'.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded file content. For text files, encode the UTF-8 bytes. For binary, encode raw bytes.

metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata to attach to the object. e.g. {'source':'e2e-test','operator':'admin'}.
